description.zh:
是否为伸缩组开启删除保护。取值范围：

- true：开启删除保护功能。开启删除保护功能后，不能在控制台或者通过调用API删除伸缩组。如果需要删除该伸缩组，必须先关闭删除保护功能。
- false：关闭删除保护功能。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the scaling group. Valid values:

- true: Enables deletion protection. After deletion protection is enabled, the scaling group cannot be deleted in the console or by calling an API operation. To delete the scaling group, disable deletion protection first.
- false: Disables deletion protection.

Default value: false.
The region ID of the scaling group.
The ID of the scaling group.

title.zh: 为伸缩组开启或关闭删除保护
title.en: Enable or disable deletion protection for a scaling group

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess set-group-deletion-protection --group-deletion-protection true --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
